reading.text: On Sunday we go to Grandma's house for dinner. First, I lay the table. I put the plates and forks on the big kitchen table. reading.title: A Cold Night
reading.text: Last night it was very cold. I put on a warm blanket and a soft pillow was under my head. My old mattress is hard, but I like it. I set the alarm for six o'clock because we had an early train. Before bed I drew the curtains, and my clothes were in the wardrobe. In the morning the alarm went off and I jumped out of bed. reading.text: On Saturday we went to the beach. I took my beach towel and my sunglasses. After I swam, I dried myself with the towel and sat in the sun.
